description: Verifies the assistant can use configured free AI providers, report their status and daily usage, and recover when the preferred provider is rate-limited.
steps: Sign in and open a project
Open the Assistant panel and verify Gemini and Groq configuration states appear without exposing API keys
Select Auto and ask a project question
Verify a useful response and the daily request count increase
Choose Gemini first or Groq first and submit another question
Simulate a rate-limit response from the preferred provider and verify the fallback provider answers
For Continue Project AI structure, simulate Groq failed_generation and verify a JSON-only retry produces a valid scaffold
expected: The assistant returns a useful response through Gemini 3.8 Flash Interactions API or Groq, automatically falls back on transient quota or availability errors, retries Groq scaffold generation without constrained JSON mode after failed_generation and validates the returned JSON before saving, and daily usage increments without exposing secrets.

description: Verifies Nova can propose real project file edits, show a review before mutation, leave files untouched on rejection, and apply only after explicit approval.
steps: Sign in and open a project
Open Nova Assistant and choose Edit with approval
Request a small change to an existing file
Inspect the proposed file content and reason
Reject and verify the source remains unchanged
Generate the proposal again and choose Approve & apply
Verify the editor and reload both show the approved content
Change a file after proposal generation and verify stale approval is rejected
expected: No source file changes before approval; rejection is a no-op; approval updates only the reviewed files; stale proposals are rejected with a refresh/retry message.

description: Verifies authentication, project boundaries and invalid file operations are guarded with clear user feedback, and provider credentials remain backend-only. It also verifies owner-only Render Static Site creation, manual deployment, service association and safe reset.
steps: Load Nova IDE without signing in and verify the sign-in screen appears as a normal signed-out state
Attempt to access a protected project API without a session and verify access is denied
Enter a valid administrator username with an incorrect password and verify sign-in is rejected
Call the assistant status route and verify it returns only configured booleans and usage counts, never key values
Inside an authorized project, attempt to create two files with the same name in one folder
Cancel a folder deletion confirmation
As a project teammate, attempt DELETE /api/projects/:id and verify the server denies the request
As the project owner, click the delete icon on a dashboard project card and cancel the yellow warning dialog
Verify the project and its files remain visible after cancellation
As the project owner, confirm deletion of a disposable test project
Verify project-scoped live collaboration subscriptions are removed with the workspace
Refresh the dashboard and verify the deleted project no longer appears
Sign in, open a shared project, refresh the browser tab, and verify the same project workspace is restored without returning to the login screen
As NP, verify Continue Project appears only after all three role assignments are accepted
Open Continue Project and verify AI structure, external prompt, and ZIP or folder import choices are available
Verify no setup choice runs until the owner explicitly selects it
Sign in as the project owner and open a project Deployment Center
Choose Verify all 4 connections
Verify each provider displays a connected, rejected or not-configured result without displaying its token
Sign in as a regular project teammate and attempt the provider verification endpoint
Verify the teammate receives an authorization error and no credential information
As a regular project teammate, attempt the GitHub push endpoint and verify it is denied
As a regular project teammate, attempt POST /api/projects/:id/vercel/deploy and verify it is denied before any Vercel API request is made
Verify the Vercel history endpoint only returns records for the authorized project
As a regular project teammate, attempt POST /api/projects/:id/netlify/deploy and verify it is denied before any Netlify API request is made
Verify the Netlify history endpoint only returns records for the authorized project
As the project owner, deploy a static HTML project to Netlify and verify a draft URL and deployment status are shown
Verify a Vite project without dist/index.html is blocked with a build-output message
Verify a Vite project with dist/index.html uploads only the dist contents and creates a draft deployment
As the project owner, try to push to a repository where the connected GitHub account lacks write access and verify a clear permission error appears
Sign in as the project owner and open Deployment Center
Load the available Render workspaces without exposing the API key
Search the selected workspace for existing Render Static Sites
Verify only unassigned static sites are offered and connect one existing service
Verify the connected service URL and deployment history appear without creating or changing the Render service
Select a workspace and enter a connected GitHub repository, branch, build command and publish directory
Create the Render Static Site and verify the service URL and initial deployment ID are shown
Verify the Render service has automatic deployments disabled
Wait for the initial Render build and refresh deployment status
Trigger a manual deployment and verify a new deployment appears in history
As the project owner, use Reset Render connection and verify the service link disappears from NOVA while the actual Render service and live site remain available
Sign in as a regular project teammate and verify service creation, manual deployment and Render connection reset are denied
expected: Anonymous and invalid operations remain denied, duplicate names are rejected, deletion cancellation preserves data, only the project owner can permanently delete a workspace, confirmed deletion removes the project and its NOVA IDE-owned records, including live collaboration subscriptions, external provider resources are not deleted, provider secrets stay private, a signed-in member returns to the same project after refresh, and only the owner can manually choose one of the three setup paths after all teammates accept. Provider credential verification, GitHub publishing and Vercel Preview and Netlify draft deployment creation are owner-only; GitHub, Vercel and Netlify tokens never reach the browser; Netlify drafts do not replace production; deployment history is scoped to the project; permission failures are visible; and obvious secret files are excluded. Only the project owner can create, manually deploy, connect or reset a Render connection. Existing services are fetched from the selected accessible workspace, restricted to unassigned Static Sites, and revalidated server-side before linking. A Render service cannot be connected to multiple NOVA IDE projects. Connecting an existing service does not create, delete, redeploy or modify it. Reset removes only NOVA IDE's saved project-to-service association; it does not delete the actual Render service, its deployments, or its live URL. The API key never reaches the browser. Newly created services remain linked to the selected workspace and repository with auto-deploys off; their initial build, live URL and deployment history are visible and refreshable.

The GitHub publisher pushes the selected workspace files and editable metadata to the connected existing repository, excludes obvious secrets and build folders, and displays the resulting commit details.
